name: Long weekend - 2 day walk
description:
The proposed walk will ascend up Bullocky Tom's Track and descend Foxlee's Track with an overnight camp at DCK Shelter.

Full details can be provided on request but the ascent and descent will be steep.
This will be a full pack walk (minus tent) and participants need to be self sufficient.

To RSVP please contact Wilfred (details provided via email 12/6 - June Newsletter) or email tsvbush@hotmail.com.

name: The Cascades
description:
The Cascades are in the Palm Creek/St Margaret's Creek area. The walk will include both on track and off track walking, rock hopping and scrambling up the sides of waterfalls.  Along the way we'll be rewarded with some impressive rocks, lovely waterfalls and a great view over the Cromarty Wetlands.

This will be a full day walk. 

Cost: members = free, visitors = $5 pp.
All participants must be 18+ years of age

RSVP is essential: please contact Phil on the number provided via email on Wed 12/6 (June Newsletter) or email the club on tsvbush@hotmail.com :)

Hope to see you on a walk soon!

name: June Bushwalk Planning Meeting
description:
The Townsville Bushwalking Club June walk planning meeting will be held on Monday 10 June @6pm at Blessed Mary Mackillop Parish meeting room (building behind the Church), 43 Ross River Road Mundingburra. 

We will be discussing walks for the rest of June/beginning of July. If you're interested in joining us on one of these walks please come along.

All welcome.

name: Bambaroo Track
description:
Due to many local track closures/restricted access/weather forecast we're heading off to do Bambaroo Track this Sunday.
This will be a steep walk on dirt and rainforest tracks (climbing from sea level to approx 750m elevation).

Highlights include the amazing tree in the photo above :) 

This will be an out and back walk and it's anticipated it will take all day eg 8am to 5pm + travel.

Want to come?  Contact Keith (details have been distributed by email) or email tsvbush@hotmail.com by Friday night.
